description: This PHP file defines the EmployeeDependentsController class within the OrangeHRM PIM plugin, responsible for handling views related to employee dependents. It extends a base controller and manages component setup and permissions based on employee number provided in HTTP requests.

classes.name: EmployeeDependentsController
classes.description: Controller managing employee dependents view, extending the base employee view controller, configuring components and permissions based on HTTP request data.

methods.name: preRender
methods.description: Prepares the dependents component for rendering, setting employee number and permissions, or handles bad requests if employee number is missing.

methods.name: getDataGroupsForCapabilityCheck
methods.description: Returns the data groups relevant for capability checks, specifically for dependents.
